# Errors

The base type of the errors a mutation returns as data, and the exception that validation converts into one.

## `ErrorType` {#strawchemy-schema-interfaces-ErrorType}

[source](https://github.com/gazorby/strawchemy/blob/v0.24.0/src/strawchemy/schema/interfaces.py#L15)

Base class for GraphQL errors.

### `id` {#strawchemy-schema-interfaces-ErrorType-id}

```python
id: str = ErrorId.ERROR.value
```



## `InputValidationError` {#strawchemy-validation-base-InputValidationError}

[source](https://github.com/gazorby/strawchemy/blob/v0.24.0/src/strawchemy/validation/base.py#L20)

```python
InputValidationError(validation: ValidationProtocol[Any], exception: Exception) -> None
```

Exception raised when input validation fails.

This exception wraps the original validation error and provides a method to convert
it to a GraphQL-compatible error type.

**Attributes:**

Name | Type | Description
---- | ---- | -----------
[`validation`](#strawchemy-validation-base-InputValidationError-validation) |  | The validation protocol instance that failed
[`exception`](#strawchemy-validation-base-InputValidationError-exception) |  | The original exception that was raised during validation

Initialize with the validation instance and original exception.

**Parameters:**

Name | Type | Description | Default
---- | ---- | ----------- | -------
`validation` | <code>ValidationProtocol[Any]</code> | The validation protocol instance that failed | *required*
`exception` | <code>Exception</code> | The original exception that was raised | *required*

### `detail` {#strawchemy-validation-base-InputValidationError-detail}

```python
detail: str = detail
```

### `exception` {#strawchemy-validation-base-InputValidationError-exception}

```python
exception = exception
```

### `graphql_type` {#strawchemy-validation-base-InputValidationError-graphql_type}

```python
graphql_type() -> ValidationErrorType
```

Convert the validation error to a GraphQL-compatible error type.

**Returns:**

Type | Description
---- | -----------
<code>ValidationErrorType</code> | A GraphQL-compatible error type that can be returned in a response

### `validation` {#strawchemy-validation-base-InputValidationError-validation}

```python
validation = validation
```
